Test Case Description: Verify Groups screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in with access to MicroFinance View modules
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Maintenance | 2. Navigate to View > Groups | 3. Wait for load completion
Expected Result: Groups screen loads with Groups table Summary Information section and action panel visible

Test Case Description: Verify hidden module ID value is rendered
Preconditions: Screen opened from parent module with module context
Test Steps: 1. Inspect hidden field moduleId_groups
Expected Result: Hidden module ID field exists and contains passed module context value

Test Case Description: Verify header controls visibility
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe top header controls
Expected Result: Refresh and Close buttons are visible with proper icon title and aria labels

Test Case Description: Verify Groups section default expanded state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe Groups section on load
Expected Result: Groups section is expanded and table is visible

Test Case Description: Verify Summary Information section default expanded state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe Summary Information section on load
Expected Result: Summary Information section is expanded and Total Members field is visible

Test Case Description: Verify section toggle collapse and expand behavior
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Collapse Groups section and expand again | 2. Collapse Summary section and expand again
Expected Result: Section content visibility toggles correctly and chevron icon states update

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads group list data
Preconditions: Backend has group data for current context

Expected Result: Groups list is loaded into table with expected rows

Test Case Description: Verify Total Members summary field updates after View

Test Case Description: Verify Refresh action reloads latest data
